name: Upscale Image
description: Make a picture two or four times larger with its detail restored (PNG). Runs on OAIY's engine (Real-ESRGAN) or a service you add; service engine:upscale is the engine's.
doc:
Enlarges a picture two or four times, restoring detail rather than blurring it.

**Service** — `OAIY engine` uses the upscaler set up in OAIY's Engines (Real-ESRGAN x4plus; pictures up to about 4 megapixels). You can also pick one of your own services: it is sent the picture as a data: URL in `{{image}}` and the scale in `{{scale}}`, and should answer with the new picture.

**In → out** — any picture in; a PNG data URL out, which Image View and Image Save take.

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Which model or service enlarges the picture. Add models in OAIY's Engines, or your own services (Python rigs) in OAIY's Services.

properties.name: Scale
properties.description: How much larger the picture becomes.
